data.exact_reserve_text: The profit on the technical account of GBP 66.5m (2019: profit GBP 31.2m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 33.5m for prior accident years (2019: GBP 18.5m deficit). This included a deficit of GBP 20.3m for reinsurance acceptance business and a deficit of GBP 13.2m on direct business (2019: deficit of GBP 22.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 4.3m on direct business).

named_events.loss_description: The 2019 current accident year was not exposed to any catastrophe events, whereas for 2020 two notable events have been recorded as such; Hurricane Laura (Cat Code 20M) and Coronavirus, ("Covid-19") which started in Wuhan, China in December 2019 and transformed into a global pandemic. The impact to the Syndicate result across both events was a gross loss of GBP 33.2m and net loss of GBP 27.2m, representing 6.0% of the current accident year ratio.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 33.5 million for prior accident years, representing a 4.55% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was primarily driven by an increase in the loss estimate for the 2019 Golden Ray marine loss, which accounted for GBP 16.8 million gross. This adverse development was partially offset by a GBP 19.7 million gross loss improvement from the 2020 subrogation impact of the 2018 Camp Wildfire event. The overall movement indicates adverse claims development and large loss development.
